thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Significant spike in 5xx from api-gateway-edge (us-east-1). 502/504 rate = 18% over last 5m (baseline ~0.3%). Sources: edge-proxy-* hosts. Pager: @sre-oncall. Link: https://telemetry.redwood/status/graph?range=5m&metric=api.gateway.5xx

sre-oncall: I'm on it — starting triage. Pinging infra and platform. Confirming scope: how many requests failing and which routes?

matt_g: grabbing quick counts from telemetry: total requests 5m = 1.2M, error_count(502|504)=216k. Top impacted routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Error spike starts ~09:11:18 UTC.

anya_r: seeing a correlated increase in connect_timeouts from the edge to backend pool (edge -> gw-cluster-b). Envoy upstream_5xx and upstream_timeout metrics tick up.

caroline: support reports initial customer tickets: ~15 orgs reporting failures in last 20m. Estimated 8% of active keys affected (likely those routed via us-east-1).

infra-bot: auto-detection: a recent config push (edge-proxy v2.1.3) deployed at 09:09:50 UTC to 60% of edge nodes in us-east-1. Rollout jobs show increased error rate on hosts with new config.

sre-oncall: ok — possible rollout regression. Matt/Anya, can you confirm whether failures are only on nodes with v2.1.3?

matt_g: running quick filter...
```bash
# list edge nodes with 5xx > 5%
telemetry query "top hosts where api.gateway.5xx_rate > 0.05 and region == 'us-east-1'" --since 10m
# result: edge-proxy-23, edge-proxy-27, edge-proxy-31 show >12% 5xx and are tagged v2.1.3
```

anya_r: confirmed. Nodes tagged v2.1.3 have CPU spike at process level + more upstream timeouts. No obvious OOM or kernel issues. Logs show repeated ECONNRESET and upstream slow responses.

caroline: immediate customer-impact summary: public API error rate high for users hitting us-east-1; some international users may hit other regions unaffected. Support is preparing comms; we need ETA for mitigation.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan proposals: 1) pause/rollback the v2.1.3 rollout (stop more nodes from receiving it) 2) route traffic away from affected edge nodes (fail traffic to healthy region or older version) 3) enable aggressive circuit-breaker/timeouts on envoys to reduce backend pressure. I'll start with 1 and 2 in parallel.

matt_g: initiating rollback to v2.1.2 on edge-proxy group for us-east-1. Command: `deployctl rollback edge-proxy --version v2.1.2 --region us-east-1 --grace 30s`

infra-bot: rollback job queued id=rb-452350-01. Expected 10 min to fully scale down v2.1.3 and bring back v2.1.2 to parity.

anya_r: meanwhile I'm updating envoy route weights for the gw-cluster to divert 80% traffic to other healthy regions (us-west-2) and 20% to us-east-1 to keep control plane checks. Patch below:
```yaml
patch: |
  - op: replace
    path: /clusters/gw-cluster/traffic_split
    value: { us-east-1: 0.2, us-west-2: 0.8 }
```

sre-oncall: apply that patch now, and enable a per-route 1s upstream timeout and 3 retries -> short-circuit.

matt_g: applied patch at 09:19:40 UTC. Envoy configs reloaded. Monitor: 502 rate down on edge-proxy-31 from 18% -> 7% in 60s.

caroline: support: we posted a brief note to the affected customers cohort informing them we're investigating and have enacted traffic diversion. Suggested holding off on broad status page update until impact assessment more stable.

support-led: prepared a short customer template: "We're seeing elevated 502/504 errors for requests routed to our us-east-1 gateway. We've diverted traffic and are rolling back a recent edge proxy change. We'll update within 30 minutes." Ready to publish on your go.

matt_g: rollback progress: rb-452350-01 reporting 55% complete at 09:24:10. No new config pushes during rollback.

anya_r: probing backend (gw-cluster-b) health: upstream pod logs show slower response times for /internal/compute endpoint — increased queue length but not crashed. Backend autoscaler isn't triggering because CPU is spiking but within thresholds. We should tighten autoscaling or reduce concurrency for now.

sre-oncall: temporary step: reduce max concurrent requests per worker on gateway service: set ENV CONCURRENCY=40 -> rolling restart. Doing that on gw-cluster-b node pool.

infra-bot: concurrency patch applied to gw-cluster-b: rollout id rc-452350-c1, expected 4 minutes to stabilize.

matt_g: metrics: overall 5xx rate for us-east-1 down to 3.9% at 09:30:05. Customer tickets still trickling but severity reduced.

caroline: tally of affected customers now 6 orgs actively seeing errors (down from 15). Impact window estimate: 09:11 — 09:28 for most customers; some saw intermittent errors until 09:33.

support-led: publishing status update now: "Mitigation in progress: traffic diverted and rollback started. Partial recovery observed; we're monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes or earlier."

sre-oncall: good. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. If rollback fully completes and metrics stable for 10m, we'll close the pager. Assigning follow-up: Anya to run postmortem capture of the rollout job and config differences. Matt to validate rollback integrity and confirm no DB or other regressions. Caroline/support to finalize customer comms close.

anya_r: note for postmortem: v2.1.3 introduced a new connection pooling behavior (keepalive tweaks) and a smaller socket buffer default; combination likely increased upstream timeouts under certain traffic patterns. Collecting diffs from the repo and the deployment manifest.

matt_g: rollback finished at 09:36:12, all us-east-1 edge nodes back to v2.1.2. Final metrics: us-east-1 5xx = 0.6% at 09:38:00. No new crashes.

caroline: support update: posted resolution message to affected customers and created follow-up tickets to contact customers who had business-critical incidents.

sre-oncall: closing active mitigation. We'll keep an eye for 60m then create an incident P1 if regression reappears. Great cross-team run. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident summary created: id INC-4523500000. Impact: elevated 502/504 in us-east-1 due to v2.1.3 edge-proxy rollout regression. Mitigation: rollback to v2.1.2, traffic diversion, concurrency reduction on gateway pool. Recovery observed ~09:36 UTC. Postmortem owner: @anya_r. Timeline: https://incidents.redwood/INC-4523500000/timeline

support-led: I'll follow up with customer outreach and close tickets as resolved.

matt_g: leaving a note to correlate logs: grep for "keepalive" and "socketbuf" in the edge-proxy change set and run load reproduction on staging.
